original_ai_output.title_zh: 乌干达对从刚果（金）返回的公民实施21天隔离
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 乌干达卫生部宣布，从邻国刚果（金）返回的乌干达公民将自费接受21天隔离，并禁止大多数曾到访刚果（金）的旅客过境。此举旨在遏制埃博拉病毒传播；刚果（金）自5月以来已有超过4800人死亡。此前有两名经乌干达中转的旅客在肯尼亚和尼日利亚被检测出埃博拉阳性。乌干达强调其境内尚未报告病例。

key_facts.fact: 乌干达对从刚果（金）返回的公民实施21天自费隔离
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: It said returning Ugandans would "undergo 21 days of quarantine at their own cost".

key_facts.fact: 乌干达不允许大多数曾到访刚果（金）的旅客过境
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: travellers who had been to DR Congo would not be allowed to transit through Uganda

key_facts.fact: 刚果（金）自5月以来已有超过4800人死于埃博拉
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: More than 4,800 people have died in DR Congo since May - the country's deadliest outbreak of the disease

key_facts.fact: 乌干达加强恩德培国际机场及所有陆路口岸的旅客筛查
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: intensified traveller screening at Entebbe International Airport and all land border crossings

key_facts.fact: 两名经乌干达中转的旅客在肯尼亚和尼日利亚被检测出埃博拉阳性
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: two people who had travelled through the country tested positive for Ebola, in Kenya and Nigeria
